items.category: the replication daemon (repd) for Shared Memory-base
items.synopsis: During ISSU the repd experiences a process crash in the master RE during the image validation phase
items.description: On MX240/480/960 with dual REs (Routing Engine), when performing ISSU (In-Service Software Upgrade) from 23.4R1 to 24.4R1, the replication service daemon (repd) will core in master Routing Engine (RE) during image validation phase. The master RE becomes unresponsive, and the system drops to emergency shell mode (# prompt).

items.synopsis: The rpd process will crash when secondary route in VRF is auto-exported
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platform, the rpd process will crash when an IPv6 (Internet Protocol Version 6) BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) - Labeled route is leaked using rib-groups to VRF (Virtual Routing and Forwarding) table and auto exported to IPv6 VPN(Virtual Private Network) table.

items.synopsis: Post configuration changes on an AE interface MPLS traffic is discarded for other interfaces/AE interface on a different FPC
items.description: On Junos Evolved PTX10008, PTX10016, PTX10004 platforms having JNP10K-LC1201/LC1202 and multiple FPCs (Flexible PIC (Physical Interface Cards) Concentrators), it is observed that when any of the following configuration changes are performed on a given AE (Aggregate Ethernet) interface, this may cause MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching) traffic to be dropped on other interfaces or AE interfaces hosted on other FPCs having the same PIC and port number as the intended AE interface members where no such configuration change is made. When family MPLS is removed from an AE interface, or When an AE interface with family MPLS configured is deactivated, or When the IFD (Interface Device) MTU (Maximum Transmission Unit) is modified on the AE interface that has family MPLS configured, or When "vlan-tagging" is added or removed on an AE interface that has family MPLS configured, or When "encapsulation" is added or removed on an AE interface that has family MPLS configured PTX10003, PTX10001-36, PTX10002-36QDD are not exposed.MPLS Traffic drops are recorded as 'normal discard' under "show pfe statistics traffic"

items.synopsis: jnud continues to further sync with the MX controller when the schema tar file failed to secure copy from satellite to the controller
items.description: On Junos Node Unifier (JNU) topology when the schema tar file failed to secure copy (scp) from satellite to the controller, the jnud process continues synchronizing with the MX Series controller.

items.synopsis: EXP rewrite not working on AE interface after system reboot.
items.description: The rewrite profile and associated opcodes are not correctly programmed in hardware after a reboot. This is confirmed by the absence of the profile in VTY dumps.

items.synopsis: Default route installation fails on Junos OS Evolved ACX Series platforms
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved ACX Series platforms, default route installation fails when repeated default route relearning happens which could be due to reasons like LSP (Label Switched Path) flaps, interface flaps etc. The packets destined for unknown destination are dropped causing outage.

items.synopsis: The evo-pfemand process crashes on ACX platforms without specific trigger
items.description: On all Junos Evolved ACX platforms, evo-pfemand process crash is seen in a rare scenario when target next-hop is received with type Reject.

items.synopsis: File Descriptor leak in fibd process leads to core files of different processes such as Jade, SSHd and Stunnel.
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved platforms, when fibd reaches the process limit on the maximum number of allowed open file descriptors, fibd is unable to open new file descriptors and track new reader processes. Given this, processes such as Jade, SSHd and Stunnel are not found by fibd, triggering the core files for these processes affecting device management and Tx/Rx packet process. The Soft Limit value within the "cat /proc//limits" output command will show the maximum number of file descriptors that fibd can have opened.

items.category: Issues related to EVO dependency layer including object graphs, incompletes, anomalies and nkdb
items.synopsis: [DCF14] [EVPN-VxLAN] After running a series of negative trigger tests on scale setup for 16 hours, traffic loss is seen in one IPv6 stream on ptx10001-36mr in CRB Spine and Border Router Role
items.description: This PR is not fixed in 23.4R2-S4 as fibd restart is not service impacting, This issue will be fixed in 23.4R2-S5-EVO

items.category: Issues related to EVO dependency layer including object graphs, incompletes, anomalies and nkdb
items.synopsis: Extremely rare core in applications
items.description: We may see a extremely rare core in applications when there are several interface flaps or interface configuration changes or reboots in a short interval of a few seconds. The issue is hard to hit and is seen only been twice even though its a day 1 issue.

items.synopsis: Boot up issue is seen during a software upgrade in ACX7100-32C/ACX7100-48L platforms running Junos Evolved
items.description: On ACX7100-32C/ACX7100-48L platforms with Innodisk Solid-State Drive (SSD), during a software upgrade, the system won't handle the partition change post-reboot, and the system will not boot properly.

items.category: Issues related to debug utilties - objmon, objshell/Dashboard
items.synopsis: Serial Console Stops Working After Cable Reconnection
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved platforms, the serial console may stop functioning, displaying a blank output, after one or more physical disconnections and reconnections of the console cable. The use of intermediate cable adapters or unreliable cables can exacerbate this issue.

items.synopsis: Mixing EP and SP style configurations on AE bundle causes traffic loss and protocol session failure on Junos OS Evolved PTX Series platforms
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved PTX Series platforms, configuring an Enterprise (EP) style logical interface (family ethernet switching) on an Aggregated Ethernet (AE) bundle that is already configured with service provider (SP) style encapsulation (flexible-ethernet-services or extended-vlan-bridge) is not supported. If the unsupported configuration is committed, traffic on the interface is dropped and protocol sessions go down.

items.synopsis: MACSec statistics will not show up in the "show interfaces statistics detail" command output
items.description: On PTX10008/PTX10016, PTX10001-36MR, PTX-10002-36QDD platforms with MACsec configured, the 'MACSec statistics' will not be displayed int the "show interfaces statistics detail" Junos CLI command output. This will not have any functional impact.

items.synopsis: jnpr.junos.facts module returns null value for the dictionary key such as hostname/junos_info
items.description: In Junos EVO platforms with systems running on X based version, jnpr.junos.facts returns null value for the Hostname and Junos Info in remote authenticated users through Radius(AAA).

items.synopsis: On Junos OS Evolved platforms, HTTPS download fails when HTTPS URL is present in the configuration
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved platforms, when HTTPS URL is present as a part of file or mentioned explicitly in the configuration, and when there is a download attempted through this file the download fails. However, this is will not impact the forwarding traffic only the download through HTTPS will fail.

items.synopsis: The jpppd process will crash with frequent subscribers login/logout
items.description: On Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, the jpppd (Juniper PPP daemon) process crash will be seen after a certain time of subscribers login/logout. The issue could also be seen with the applications that write their private data in /mfs/var/sdb/shmem/sdb_intf.ad.db, such as jl2tpd (Juniper L2TP daemon), repd (replication daemon) jdhcpd (Juniper DHCP daemon) and others.

items.category: RPD Next-hop issues including indirect, CNH, and MCNH
items.synopsis: Traffic doesn't flow with preserve-nexthop-hierarchy
items.description: Due to Nexthop sharing, when there are IP and MPLS routes pointing to same Nexthop and IP routes getting installed first, the PFE installs the NH as IP NH. This results in packet corruption for MPLS traffic due to BCM limitation.

items.category: RPD Next-hop issues including indirect, CNH, and MCNH
items.synopsis: Route processing to handle nexthop weight differences in krt module
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved platforms, In some scenario after rpd (Routing Protocol Daemon) restart, the route change is not sent from routing daemon RIB(Routing Information Base) to forwarding plane FIB (Forwarding Information Base). This results in traffic drop.

items.synopsis: On srx4700, LACP is not coming up in distributed mode
items.description: In Release 24.4R1-S2, for SRX4700: LACP will not work in a distributed mode. To check the mode: root@casinoroyale-sol-01# run show ppm interfaces detail IFL-index: 2082, Protocol: LACP Interface Key: N/A Distributed: FALSE <=== This should be False for centralized (true for distributed) LACP will continue to work fine in centralized mode. The way to enter centralized mode is through the following CLI command: >set protocols lacp ppm centralized If the LACP is in distributed mode the LACP PDU will not be exchanged with the peer device resulting in the LACP state remaining in Attached. This will cause the interface (or the ae bundle) to remain in a DOWN state. The only impact of a centralized mode is when the RE is heavily utilized and busy, we might end up loosing packets in a FAST periodic mode of LACP causing interface to flap. This behavior will be fixed in S3 release and distributed mode will be enabled again.

items.synopsis: On SRX300 series DHCP relay stops working and the device generates coredump after upgrading to JunOS 23.4R2-S2.1
items.description: On SRX300 series devices, when TACACS accounting is configured, after an upgrade to Junos 23.4R2-S2.1, the DHCP-relay may not work anymore and the shm-rtsdbd process may produce coredumps.

items.category: Configuration mgmt, ffp, load-action, commit processing
items.synopsis: Commit error check-out failed does not get triggered when a complete bridge-domain is configured in instance-type vrf.
items.description: Commit error check-out failed does not get triggered when a complete bridge-domain is configured in instance-type vrf.

items.category: Configuration mgmt, ffp, load-action, commit processing
items.synopsis: Baseline configuration commit takes more time with 256000 MAC configurations
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms with dual RE (Routing Engine), the baseline configuration commit takes more time when the device has 256000 MAC (Media Access Control) configurations configured under groups. It is a scaling issue, and occurs when a large number (256000 or more) of MAC configurations are configured. This has no impact to network traffic.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: Multiple daemons crash upon ephemeral or static db commits
items.description: On all Junos platforms with ephemeral configuration, multiple daemons like chassisd, dcd, l2ald, l2cpd, mib2d and transportd crash upon ephemeral or static db commits causing service traffic impact. The services will self recover after the issue is hit in the network.

items.synopsis: [fabric] [fabrictag] Aegon : EVO PTX10008:Aegon: some ccl is not fixed by AH, when GRES is initiated while AH is in progress
items.description: When AH is in progress and GRES happens, there is a possibility that AH may fail. In case of AH Failure, following recovery mechanisms can be tried: Try executing the AH through CLI to see if it helps. If CLI AH command does not recover the link, PFE offline/online can be tried to recover the link. If PFE offline/online also does not recover the link, then FPC offline/online can be tried.

items.synopsis: [fabric] [fabrictag] aegon: EVO PTX10008:Aegon: found voq drop during sending 16% traffic (not 16.6%) and gracefully offline 5 sibs
items.description: When multiple SIBs are offlined in succession, at times it can result in continuous traffic drops.

items.synopsis: [fabric] [fabrictag] aegon : EVO PTX10008:Aegon: pfes go to fault after several sib and pfe restart together
items.description: If multiple SIBs and PFEs are restarted together, fatal interrupt can be seen and the PFEs will remain in fault state.

items.synopsis: [PDT][MSFT][AEGON]: Aegon line card went into fault state after restart with ASAN image [24.4I20241203150203-EVO_swaradkar]
items.description: With FPC restart on a scaled system with ASAN, evo-aftmand see head-of-line blocking of platform DDS objects that may cause DMF init to timeout and the FPC to go to fault state.

items.synopsis: After the JNU config is deleted and added back jnuadmin's uid changes
items.description: Not impacting production.

items.synopsis: Jflow functionality stops working when configured with sflow
items.description: On all ACX Junos Evolved platforms running 24.2R1 and later versions, when both sFlow and JFlow services are configured simultaneously on the device, JFlow stops functioning due to mirror ID allocation conflicts. There won't be any traffic impact; the only problem is that JFlow won't be operational.

items.synopsis: DNS resolution over a routing-instance fails
items.description: Many issues were observed in EVO library regarding the DNS resolution & these were fixed in this PR

items.category: Issues related to debug utilties - objmon, objshell/Dashboard
items.synopsis: Core dumps are incomplete after unzip.
items.description: When unzipping core dump tar balls, there is an error or warning related to gzip hitting unexpected end of file.

items.category: EVO Netstack Juniper Tunnel Driver Module
items.synopsis: TCP connection stalls with BGP Explicit Null and MPLS forwarding on certain Junos Evolved PTX platforms when sending packets exceeding MTU limit
items.description: On Junos Evolved PTX10001, PTX10004 and PTX10008 platforms, if LDP(Label Distribution Protocol) is initially established over IP protocol, and later transitions to MPLS(Multiprotocol Label Switching) encapsulation (mpls-forwarding), the outgoing TCP(Transmission Control Protocol) packet size is not adjusted to account for added MPLS label. As a result, packets exceeding the configured interface MTU(Maximum Transmission Unit) are dropped before transmission. Since the receiving side does not receive these packets, the LDP session eventually times out due to "hold time expiry".

items.synopsis: Router flag is not getting set in Neighbor Advertisement message
items.description: When EVPN (Ethernet Virtual Private Network) routing instance has IRB (Integrated Routing and Bridging) interface with IPv6 (Internet Protocol version 6) address, ICMPv6 NA (Neighbour advertisement) reply from IRB IPv6 address doesn't have router flag. The ICMPv6 NA from IRB IPv6 should have router flag.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: VMX :: JDI-REG-VIRTUAL: Observed xml validation failure seen for "show host | display xml validate" and The emitted XML is INVALID.
items.description: "show host" is not properly XMLized. So from a netconf channel the XML output is encapsulated in an tag. If any automation tool plans to use the XML output of this CLI command, it may have to do some logic on its side (as the response is not 100% XMLized)
